info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Proposition Management API
info.description: The Customer Proposition Management API enables users to modify existing customer propositions within the banking system. With this operational capability, businesses can update key attributes related to customer propositions, ensuring that offerings align with market demands and customer needs. This API is particularly useful for customer relationship managers and product teams who require an agile way to adapt services and enhance customer engagement. Organizations can streamline their product management processes and maintain competitive offerings in the market.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific customer proposition identified by CUST-100045. Ensure you provide all necessary information in the request body to successfully apply the updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the customer proposition details for the specified customer ID. Please ensure the request contains valid JSON structure as per the schema defined.

200.description: The request was successful, and the customer proposition has been updated.
